description: This PHP file defines the Contact controller for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling display and processing of the Contact Us page, including rendering contact information, location details, CAPTCHA validation, and form submission handling.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Controller class for handling the contact page functionalities including displaying contact info, processing form submissions, and rendering success page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the contact page with store info, location, map, CAPTCHA, and other components.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles the sending of contact form data, validates input and CAPTCHA, and schedules email task if validation passes.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays the success message after a contact form is successfully submitted.
